tools.name: list_pdf_tools
tools.description: List every DocuGrip tool that is live, with what it does, which file formats it takes, and its URL in each supported language. Use this to see what is available.

tools.name: find_pdf_tool
tools.description: Find the DocuGrip tools that match a task, described in the user own words — for example "combine two contracts", "my scan has no searchable text", or "shrink this under 2 MB". Returns the matching tools and the URL to open.

tools.name: get_pdf_tool
tools.description: Get one DocuGrip tool by its id, for example "merge-pdf".

tools.name: get_plans
tools.description: List DocuGrip plans with their current price, billing terms, who each plan suits, and where to buy. Use this when the user asks what DocuGrip costs, whether they need to pay for a task, or which plan fits them.

tools.name: get_upload_requirements
tools.description: Look up the official file size limit and accepted format for an upload portal or service (for example IRCC, USCIS, ImmiAccount, CM/ECF, Gmail, Turnitin, Etsy) with the official source and the date it was checked, plus a compressor page already set to a safe target size. tools.name: find_official_form
tools.description: Find an official form (US IRS and USCIS, Canada, UK and more), such as W-9, W-4, 1099-NEC, I-130, I-765 or N-400, with the issuing agency source, the current edition and the date older editions are rejected, plus a page to fill and sign it in the browser. Use this when a user asks where to get, fill

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_pdf_tools, find_pdf_tool · Private data: list_pdf_tools, get_upload_requirements · Public sink: get_upload_requirements · Destructive: get_upload_requirements.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_pdf_tools, find_pdf_tool · Private data: list_pdf_tools, get_upload_requirements · Public sink: get_upload_requirements · Destructive: get_upload_requirements

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
